supersession_reason: This dry run rehearsed the smaller August branch comparison as the headline instead of the canonical 4,022-finding Tenure reconciliation.

Reveal the 684-candidate scope with the candidate-not-verdict label visible.
Move to the rejected shortcut: 127-file disposable snapshot and 15-error result.
Resolve the candidate field into the five bounded repair lanes.

checks: No credentials, tokens, email addresses, usernames, or private filesystem paths appear in the narration.
Only reviewed short revision identifiers and aggregate case counts appear.
The planned visuals use the already reviewed case-study captures, not raw terminal or provider screens.
Candidate, gate, branch, browser, and deployment labels remain visible when their claims are narrated.
redaction_check.live_capture_rule: Stop recording if any unreviewed terminal, provider, notification, account, or filesystem surface enters frame.

recovery_paths.trigger: The live case-study surface does not load or layout shifts.
recovery_paths.action: Use the reviewed desktop and mobile captures and continue the same narration.

recovery_paths.trigger: The provider branch readback cannot be refreshed.
recovery_paths.action: Use the recorded receipt and say its observation timestamp; do not imply current branch or deployment state.
Replace the responsive-surface pan with one split-screen still; retain the browser and deployment boundary sentence.

recovery_paths.trigger: A redaction concern appears during capture.
recovery_paths.action: Stop the take and restart from the last reviewed static frame; do not crop a sensitive live frame after the fact.

recovery_paths.trigger: The narration stumbles after the rejected-shortcut reveal.
recovery_paths.action: Restart at QR7-S3 and splice only on the static transition into the repair lanes.

limitations: This timing pass used synthesized speech, not the final human delivery.
The seven gates are recorded in a canonical historical report and were not freshly rerun for this rehearsal.
The branch readback is time-bound and does not prove deployment.
The reviewed browser captures cover the local case-study surface, not the Tenure product or a public page.
Final public copy, recording, captions, preview, hosting, and owner approval remain QR-8 work.
